title: Quiet Frequency
project: Quiet Frequency (working title): a 30-minute action short; this is its 120 s theatrical trailer
brief: Add cinematic trailer fx, a Yamaha R15 engine sound with gearshifts, drift SFX, the hero rides a bike and the villain chases him; make a 120 sec full trailer; the hero took something bad from earth that can be used to control people and managed to take it out from the villain, who found it in the lab and started to chase; full chasing, escape, near misses, riding under the trailer by smooth ducking; it is a trailer so no happy endings, the end should make the viewers curious; no funky jumping, big-budget Hollywood style; SFX and music blended in one space, dynamic camera motion, room physics, a walkie-talkie SFX, a different vehicle for the villain, realistic gear shifting; 7.1 8-channel delivery; loudness stays at -16 LUFS
audience: cinema and online trailer viewers who have not seen the film and want to know what the device does
purpose: make the viewer want to know what the device does and who else is listening, with no resolution
point_of_view: the Hero's, and the Villain's closing in from behind: the viewer is on the bike, hearing the car in the mirror
job: a 120 s theatrical trailer for a 30-minute action short: the Hero steals a device that can control people, the Villain finds the case empty and hunts him down a highway, there are near misses and no rescue, and the last image is a case being opened
story: a thief takes a mind-control device from a lab, the owner hunts him down a highway, and the last image is the case being opened

references: the Highway Pursuit cue: the same chase grammar, rewritten as a trailer with sound design in the arrangement

sound: the bike ahead of the camera, the V8 behind and beside it, the radio at the left ear
spatial_staging.why: the bike is in front of the viewer and the car is in the mirror: that is what makes the seat uncomfortable rather than loud

immersive.why: the chase surrounds the listener: the car comes up from behind and alongside, the truck passes through the field, the tunnel closes it, the flyover opens it

anchors.why: the road is fixed under the viewer
the Hero is ahead of the camera for the whole cue

movers.why: the Villain closes from behind and alongside
movers.path: behind and far, to behind and near, to the right side, to a metre at the ram
from far behind, past the right ear, to far in front

height_plan.why: height is for the shot, not for decoration

room_changes.why: a small hard room: the alarm and the radio are close and bright
the yard and the gate: the room opens
a tunnel bore: loud, long, dark
the deck: the tail opens and the percussion lifts
open road, a long dry tail for the one second of nothing
open air: nothing near, the engines idle
back to a small room: the case is open

gate_reason: a trailer judged on its own acts: a sound-design opening, a dense chase, one declared second of silence, a second peak and an unresolved last act
notes: no dialogue is synthesised; the walkie-talkie is squelch, carrier and beeps only. The end is deliberately unresolved (Bb minor over an F pedal).

tempo.note: 120 BPM: a bar is two seconds, so every hit lands on a whole second and the clock needs no tempo map

ending_note: a low hit, a bark of timpani, a minor subdominant (Bb minor over the F pedal) that never goes home, and the device still pulsing: no fade, a cut to black
avoid_feel_note: no victory, no joke, no stunt: heavy, cold and plain, the way a large studio trailer plays a chase
palette: strings: 16th ostinato in cellos and violas, staccato violins in the peaks
brass: horns on the cell, trombone stabs, tuba pedal
percussion: bass drum, timpani, taiko, snare, crashes
sound design: a single-cylinder bike and a V8 car, tyres, a truck horn, a radio, a lab alarm, a heartbeat, a device

sonic_picture.first_10s: a lab at night: an alarm, a radio squelch, a pulse that speeds up, one low F
sonic_picture.middle: the chase: a 16th ostinato that never stops, a V8 behind and a bike ahead, a second of nothing, a second peak louder than the first
sonic_picture.last_note: one low hit and a ring, the device still pulsing over Bb minor

expression.performer: a session orchestra playing to picture and a sound-design team riding the engines: the music is conducted from a click, the engines from the rpm
producer_moves: carve the music where the engines live and the engines where the horn lives, so both are heard
the engines duck 2-4 dB smoothly under the drums and come back over a second
leave a real second of nothing before the second peak
expression.anti_generic: no riser-impact formula and no stunt gags: the opening is sound design, the middle is a chase, the silence is written, and the end is a question
